questions.question: A national newspaper unit wants to start a satellite printing unit for their newspaper in a smaller town. The processes to be performed at the satellite unit include receiving the pages on wire by the deadline as PDF files, print the pages on an image setter, and make plates on a semi automatic plate making machine and print the pages on a web offset press. Supplement pages are likely to be printed earlier and need be stored in the premises to be delivered with the newspaper. The web off set machine is a machine is up to 16 pages per issue with 4 pages in color machine and has a foot print of 2.5 meters x 12 meters. The printing machine requires a foundation of 2x(4+4) meters. The folder and the preliminary feeder also occupy about 2 meters each. of length. The press requires an oil burner type heater and a chilling unit. An air compressor is also provided to operate the pneumatic elements. The system is controlled from a remote control panel. A diesel generator is provided to take care of power failures and need be housed in a separate unit next to the press. This is likely to be a 10^0KVA unit with canopy with a foot print of 2 × 4 meters to be adequately housed in shed. Provision for storing 200 liters of diesel is also made. The building must have a capacity to store a maximum of 50 of news paper reels some times in more than one variety and should be approachable easily from the delivery area of the news paper. The store should be so arranged that the first reels to enter would be the first ones to leave. The space above the stores may be used for the offices including the image setter, plate making, and plate storage and communication room. a. Prepare a detailed list of the equipment and the working space that has to be provided for each. b. Calculate the total built area and the plot requirement for such an activity. c. A diesel generator is provided to take care of power failures and need be housed in a separate unit next to the press. This is likely to be a 10^0KVA unit with canopy with a foot print of 2 × 4 meters to be adequately housed in shed. Provision for storing 200 liters of diesel is also made. Prepare a detailed layout of the premises to scale. d. Prepare a detailed layout of the machinery and the premises to scale. [ 04 ] + [ 04 ] + [ 04] + [ 18 ]
